title: Brightlane — champion change
description: Original champion left. New VP wants ROI proof and a narrower rollout.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Congrats on the new seat, Ana. I partnered with Jordan before — how do you want to restart?

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Jordan left last month. I'm resetting vendors. Show me ROI in thirty days or we stay with Otter.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Fair. We can measure time-to-notes and AE follow-up send rate against your current baseline.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Objection: I don't want another dashboard. My team lives in email and Salesforce.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Notes export to Markdown and JSON, and the share link drops straight into opportunity comments.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: If we proceed, start with the West region only — eight reps — not the whole org.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: West-only pilot works. I'll prepare a thirty-day scorecard with three metrics.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Send the scorecard and a sample deal-notes page from one of our anonymized calls.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: You'll have both by end of day, plus a calendar hold for a mid-pilot check-in.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: If West hits the bar, I'll expand. Intent is a decision before our QBR on the twelfth.

followUpEmail.subject: Brightlane West pilot — scorecard + sample deal notes
followUpEmail.body:
Ana —

Congrats again on the new seat. As discussed after Jordan's departure, attaching:
1) 30-day West-region scorecard (time-to-notes, AE follow-up send rate, + one more)
2) Sample deal-notes page from an anonymized call
3) Calendar hold for a mid-pilot check-in

Notes land in Markdown/JSON and share links for Salesforce comments — no extra dashboard.

If West hits the bar, we can expand before your QBR on the twelfth.

— OpenGong Lite
